title: Tools that do something
notes: fix: The suture needle, the pestle and mortar and the ward hammer did nothing at all. They were sold, forged and described as tools, and no bench ever asked for them.

balance: The anvil, the cauldron and the sewing table now want the right tool in your pack, as Smith Marrow has been saying all along. The furnace and the range still do their own work. All three tools are on Sceld's shelf for pocket money.
fix: The make window says which tool a bench wants before you click, not after.
fix: An item's tooltip says what its tool is for. "Used for gathering" was vague at best and wrong for the needle.
fix: The skills guide names the tool each resource needs — the bile gaff is for eel holes at Leeching 28, which was until now something you had to find out by owning one and wondering.

title: Sister Ambrose keeps her chapel
notes: fix: There were two Sister Ambroses. One kept the Chapel of the Uvula; the other stood in the Guild of Physicians in Vellumhaven, among the cauldrons. She would start the Long Vigil from there and then tell you to keep watch at the altar “here”, in a room that has never had one. There is one of her now, in the chapel, where the quest says she is.
fix: The Long Vigil asks for three watches in three places, one of them “not in a chapel at all” — and no such altar existed. Every one in the Throat stood in one of the two chapels.
content: A shrine on the Gullet Road, between the braziers: an altar, two graves and a sign. Somebody keeps the candles lit.
balance: The Long Vigil counts places, not altars. Three of them stand in the Uvula chapel and praying at all three was never what Ambrose meant.

title: The Cartilage Rings
notes: content: The map has grown. East of the Larynx Deep, past the cave road, the Throat opens into the Cartilage Rings — pale ribs of the stuff, standing in rows.
content: Two things live out there: ring gnawers, and whatever a chondral warden used to be. Neither is for a nurse who is still counting their first hundred.
content: Cartilage seams can be mined at Delving 45 for shards. The chondral wardens drop a splint worth carrying.
content: A waystation stands on the road in. It has a bed and a brazier and nobody in it.

title: The Sounding
notes: content: New quest — The Sounding. Sister Lull keeps a listening post in the Larynx Deep, south of the cave road. She has been there long enough to stop hearing it.
content: The post is on the map now, with a bed, a brazier and somebody in it.
content: Ward deafeners can be earned from the quest — a hood for anyone working where the Throat is loud.

title: Trading, and a bulletin board
notes: feature: Nurses can trade with each other. Click another nurse, or type /trade <name>. They have to ask you back before anything opens, the way it always worked.
feature: The trade has two screens. Offer, both accept, then a confirmation showing exactly what is about to change hands — and any change at all sends you both back to the first screen.
feature: Offered items leave your pack and are held until the trade settles. Declining, walking apart, dying or logging out all give them straight back.
feature: This bulletin. It appears once when the ward has changed, and /patch brings it back.
content: The ward can now take deliveries — new creatures, kit, recipes, quests and places arrive as content packs without the game being rebuilt around them.

title: Walking, tooltips and skill guides
notes: fix: Nurses walk instead of sliding. Arms and legs swing in opposition, and which foot leads alternates properly even at a run.
feature: Hovering an item shows what it is, where it is worn, what it does, what it is worth, and — in red — any requirement you cannot meet.
feature: Clicking a skill opens what it unlocks, level by level, read straight from the game's own data.

title: Friends, whispers and coloured chat
notes: feature: A friends list that tells you who is on shift, and tells them when you arrive.
feature: Whispers — /tell <name> <message> and /r to reply. Names with spaces go in quotes.
feature: Chat effects. Prefix a message with a colour and a motion: rainbow:wave:the ward is bleeding. /effects lists them all.
fix: A save written the instant before a reconnect can no longer be read back stale.

title: Sound, animation and slower resources
notes: feature: Music that follows you between regions, and sound effects for everything the ward does. All of it synthesised at runtime; there is not an audio file in the repository.
feature: Attack animations for nurses and for the things attacking them, gathering animations, and doors that swing.
balance: Gathering and node respawn take meaningfully longer. Resources were popping back before you had walked away.

title: The ward opens
notes: feature: Throatscape moves onto the server. Accounts, passwords and saved progress, one authoritative world, and everybody in it at once.
